source.notes: CISCE item bank of 85 competency-focused practice questions for ISC Class XI Accountancy (not an examination paper); cover prints 'ISC ... ACCOUNTANCY cLASS - xI', page 2 'First edition: August 2026', preface dated 31st August 2026 signed by the Chief Executive & Secretary. PDF page = printed page + 5; questions on PDF pages 6-41, Answer Key on PDF pages 42-66, so answerSourceUrl equals sourceUrl. Marks from section headings: I MCQ Q1-22, II Assertion-Reason Q23-32, III Very Short Answer Q33-52 (1 mark each), IV Short Answer Q53-68 (3 marks each), V Long Answer Q69-80 (6 marks each), VI Very Long Answer Q81-85 (10 marks each; Q82 prints [6]+[4]); full bank total 222. THIS PACK IS PARTIAL: only Q1-68 (100 marks) are included; Q69-85 were not extracted and remain to be added. Printed topic tags are omitted from the text; printed cognitive tags are recorded as printed. Tables are flattened row by row with ' | ' from page renders and flagged. Answer Key copied as printed, not extended (preface: 'neither limiting nor exhaustive'). Key entries that look questionable are kept as printed for editor review: Q3 '(a) Direct expenses' for purchase of land; Q12 '(a) ₹1,95,000' (the given figures give ₹1,92,000); Q39 '₹4,98,200' (4,70,000/0.94 = 5,00,000).

questions.text:
An owner's contribution into business is credited to the Capital Account.
From the following, choose the correct Accounting Concept which is used to credit Capital Account.

officialAnswer.text: (d) Business Entity Concept

questions.text: Identify from the following options, which one of them is a direct expense?

officialAnswer.text: (a) Wages of Machine Operators

questions.text:

The land was purchased for the purpose of developing premium and luxury residence with a gross sales value of more than ₹2300 crore.

officialAnswer.text: (a) Direct expenses

questions.text: The difference between what a sole trader owns and what he/she owes to outsiders is termed as:

officialAnswer.text: (b) Capital

questions.text:
A sole trader pays the premium for Life insurance policy using money from the business current account.
The above transaction will be reflected in the financial statement as:
options: On the debit side of Trading A/c
On the debit side of Profit and Loss A/c
On the asset side of the Balance Sheet
Way of deduction from capital in the Balance Sheet

officialAnswer.text: (d) Way of deduction from capital in the balance sheet

questions.text:
The increasing importance of accountants helped to transform accounting into a profession, first in the UK and then in the US. In 1904, eight people formed the London Association of Accountants to open the profession to a wider audience of people than was available through the UK’s older associations. After several name changes, the London Association of Accountants adopted the name the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) in 1996.
(Edited Source: http://www.accaglobal.com/)
Out of the following, which body in India represents the accounting profession similar to ACCA?

officialAnswer.text: (b) ICAI

questions.text:

questions.text:
Following particulars are provided by Cosmo Ltd.:
Purchase price of a machine ₹60,000
Wages paid for installing the machine ₹4,000
Repairing charges for a year (approx.) ₹2,000
Estimated scrap value ₹14,000
Useful life of the machine 10 years
Answer the following:
(a) Calculate the amount of annual depreciation chargeable for the machine.
(b) Adjusting and Closing entry for depreciation at the end of first year.
Note: Assets Account is maintained at Book Value.
extractionIssues: Official answer is a table on page 46; reproduced row by row with ' | ' from a page render; check against the PDF

officialAnswer.text:
(a) Depreciation per year = 60,000+4,000-14,000 = 50,000/10 = ₹5,000
(b) Journal:
Depreciation A/c… Dr. 5,000; To Machine A/c 5,000 (Being adjusting entry/ Depreciation charged)
Statement of Profit & Loss Dr. 5,000; To Depreciation 5,000 (Being closing entry)
